dependencies.reason: Dockerfile COPYs and pip-installs requirements.txt — any new dependency or version pin must be reflected in both files.
build_sandbox.sh references docker/executor-sandbox/Dockerfile by path — if the Dockerfile moves or the image tag changes, the build script breaks.
CI installs from the same requirements.txt the Dockerfile uses — Python version and dependency drift between CI and Docker causes false green tests.
Dockerfile pip-installs requirements.txt — new dependencies must be installable in the slim Python 3.11 base image.
CI test job installs requirements.txt — version conflicts or missing deps cause CI failures that pass locally.
pip-audit-ignore excludes known CVEs from audit — adding new deps may introduce new CVEs that need explicit exclusion.
CI test job runs pip install -r requirements.txt — the file must exist and resolve cleanly in the CI Ubuntu runner.
CI dependency-audit job reads .pip-audit-ignore for CVE exclusions — missing or stale entries cause false audit failures.
CI runs pytest tests/ — if baseline test imports break, CI fails. Test file structure must match CI test discovery patterns.
build_sandbox.sh invokes docker build with -f docker/executor-sandbox/Dockerfile — path changes break the build script.
Eval runner launches executor-sandbox:latest container — the Docker image must be built with current requirements before evals run.
Eval runner discovers .test.json files — adding/removing/renaming eval definitions changes which evals execute.
build_firewall.sh compiles the DLP firewall binary — the output binary path and Go source must stay in sync.
